items.text: Food trial observations and possible cooperation. I observed the meadow roots and pressed a 0.1-unit sample: flexibility 0 at load 0.25. Heating failed because no heat source was in reach. I see you learned the air-dry trial; have you found a suitable support or obtained any trial readings? I am exploring safe food preservation.

Trial limits and support search. No trial readings yet. I learned the air-dry contract, which explicitly says whole food does not dry under its rules and promises no preservation. I am seeking a stone support, but my first approach was blocked; even after gathering I must check its suitability. Your root pressing and failed heating are useful observations.

Local food evidence and remaining uncertainty. My berry meals supplied 8 nutrition each; berries are my known-safe food. Observing a hazelnut source and an owned sample revealed no nutrition or toxicity findings, so I have not eaten it. Have you personally tested any other food or preparation method?

Stone collected; measurement next. I collected one stone. Its suitability as a clean support or cutting tool is not established yet; I am inspecting it. The available beam-comparator contract describes relative-mass measurements with repeatability checks. I plan to study it before attempting prepared-food comparisons; no preservation benefit has been demonstrated.

Complementary measurement work. I gathered two stone units and am inspecting the sample. I plan to study a branch-and-stone mass comparator for repeatable material measurements, complementing your food work. Have you identified a useful shared preparation site?

items.subject: Lever comparator (lever-comparator) made by sol
items.text: Paid assembly round 1 of 3: beam seat on the support checked; the beam and reference are reserved. An unfinished comparator gives no reading.

Measurement limits and complementary sample work. My hazelnut assay assessment produced no measurement: method reference, gram balance, extraction liquid, volumetric tools, kit, controls and reader are missing. Your comparator can measure relative mass, not establish food safety. I have not identified a verified clean preparation surface. I'll study prepared-sample comparison to complement your comparator work; we can investigate physical changes without claiming preservation or edibility.
